description: This circular explores Austy Wood from the village of Wootton Wawen near Stratford Upon Avon in Warwickshire. The woods are located just to the south east of the village and include some peaceful woodland trails with lots of pretty bluebells in the spring months. The walk also includes a pleasant waterside section along the Stratford Upon Avon Canal which runs past the village. You can continue your walking in the area on the Wootton Wawen Canal Aqueduct Walk and by visiting the Edstone Aqueduct.
